input: Find a reliable accountant for self-employment taxes

gold.taskTitle: Find a reliable accountant for self-employment taxes
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to find and hire a trustworthy accountant who can handle their self-employment tax needs.

questions.title: What type of self-employment work do you do?
questions.description: Understanding the industry or profession helps identify accountants with relevant expertise.

questions.title: Have you worked with an accountant before?
questions.description: Knowing their prior experience helps gauge what kind of guidance and onboarding support they may need.

questions.title: Do you need help with filing only, or ongoing tax advice?
questions.description: Clarifies whether this is a one-time filing need or a continuous advisory relationship.

questions.title: What is your budget for accounting services?
questions.description: Budget constraints will shape which tier of accountant or firm is realistic to pursue.

questions.title: Do you prefer someone local or are you open to remote?
questions.description: Location preference determines whether to search locally or consider nationwide online services.

questions.title: How complex is your income, any multiple streams or expenses?
questions.description: Complexity of income and deductions affects the level of expertise required in the accountant.

questions.title: When do you need the accountant ready to start?
questions.description: Timeline urgency, such as an upcoming tax deadline, affects how quickly the search must move.
